name: council
description: Decisions about code that can be shipped or held: five have a flaw a careful reviewer finds, one is sound. Run it without --council and with it (after setting a council up on the Providers page) and compare; a difference under 3 points is noise until it repeats. A development comparison, not a benchmark.
